discord.text:
**EIA Sees Oil Supply Nearing Pre-War Levels as Hormuz Flows Resume**

The agency expects crude output and trade to recover near pre-conflict levels by year-end, shifting the market test from disruption to inventories and demand.

**Why it matters:** Reopened Hormuz transit, restored shut-in production and rebuilding inventories determine whether the supply recovery translates into a durable decline in crude prices.

Full analysis: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/eia-sees-oil-supply-nearing-pre-war

For informational purposes only; not financial advice.

EIA Sees Oil Supply Nearing Pre-War Levels as Hormuz Flows Resume

The agency expects crude output and trade to recover near pre-conflict levels by year-end, shifting the market test from disruption to inventories and demand.

The mechanism: Reopened Hormuz transit, restored shut-in production and rebuilding inventories determine whether the supply recovery translates into a durable decline in crude prices.

The policy context: Lower gasoline prices can ease headline inflation, but Federal Reserve policy still depends on broader price persistence, labor conditions and inflation expectations.

Read the full Capital Chronicle analysis: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/eia-sees-oil-supply-nearing-pre-war

For informational purposes only; not financial advice.
